initiatives.name: Northwest Arkansas Democratic Socialists of America
initiatives.description: Northwest Arkansas chapter of Democratic Socialists of America, with working groups on Gaza solidarity, electoral politics, labor, public transit and mutual aid.

initiatives.name: NWA Socialist Alternative
initiatives.description: Northwest Arkansas branch of Socialist Alternative, a national socialist organization.

initiatives.name: Hands Up NWA
initiatives.description: A grassroots organization fostering mutual aid and community support through direct action and solidarity initiatives in Northwest Arkansas. They coordinate resource sharing, community organizing, and support networks while building power through local advocacy and creating spaces for collective care.

initiatives.name: Mayday NWA
initiatives.description: A community-based mutual aid network in Northwest Arkansas focused on direct support and solidarity initiatives. They work to build community power through resource sharing, emergency assistance, and collective organizing while fostering sustainable networks of care and support.

initiatives.name: NWA Food Not Bombs
initiatives.description: Volunteer group that recovers food and serves free vegetarian and vegan meals in Walker Park, Fayetteville, on the last Sunday of each month at noon.

initiatives.name: NWA for Palestine
initiatives.description: Northwest Arkansas group organizing rallies and marches in Fayetteville in support of Palestinians, including weekly protests in 2024.

initiatives.name: Friends of Palestine NWA
initiatives.description: Palestine solidarity group in Northwest Arkansas that holds weekly demonstrations in Fayetteville and educates the community about Palestine. Has affiliated groups in Little Rock and Fort Smith.

initiatives.name: The Equality Crew
initiatives.description: Springdale-based nonprofit running social programs for LGBTQ+ youth in Northwest Arkansas, including D&D campaigns, an inclusive prom, Rainbow Library book pop-ups and a teen council.
